title: THE OBSERVER PRESCRIBED TO CATCH A FROZEN POSTERIOR REPORTS HEALTHY ON A FROZEN POSTERIOR. IMPULSE_ACTIVITY_FOUNDATION's
description: THE OBSERVER PRESCRIBED TO CATCH A FROZEN POSTERIOR REPORTS HEALTHY ON A FROZEN POSTERIOR. IMPULSE_ACTIVITY_FOUNDATION's F-39 residue prescribes instrumentation for 'the general hazard of learning-signal paths — nothing downstream fails when one stops, and the only symptom is a posterior that quietly stops moving'. MEASURED 2026-09-05 05:29Z, learning_signal_health_observer returned: diagnosis 'healthy', success_credit_ratio 1, total_concepts 5000, loaded_concepts 5000, loaded_with_success 5000, one_sided false, gap_emission 'not_needed'. SIMULTANEOUS GROUND TRUTH: across a 2.6h window carrying 194 Thompson selections, activity arms were EXACTLY frozen at 3,885, cell population at 4,061, uninformed cells at 1,084 and reused paths at 592; achieved verdicts moved 0 while not_achieved moved +7. The observer measures CONCEPT CREDIT ONE-SIDEDNESS (whether loaded concepts also record success), not whether any posterior is MOVING, so it cannot detect the condition it was introduced to detect and will emit 'not_needed' indefinitely while learning is stalled. FALSIFIER: closed only when the observer emits a non-healthy diagnosis, or a gap, in response to a deliberately induced frozen-counter condition — cite the run timestamp and the counters that were frozen. A closure that does not exhibit the observer reacting to stalled posteriors is fabricated.
